Help

The following operators can be used when searching:

  • To search for solicitations containing one of the terms, use capital OR between terms
    • Ex: Construction OR Demolition
  • To search for solicitations containing all of the terms, use capital AND between terms
    • Ex: Construction AND Demolition
  • To search for solicitations using a combination of terms, use parentheses to group terms
    • Ex: (Construction AND Demolition) OR (Construction AND Electrical)
